tool_args.rationale: The nine observations cover a useful range of u_now and s_grad and exhibit a consistent base-field increase with u_now plus suppression by sink gradient; the fine trajectory batch reduces the remaining ambiguity enough to fit a compact smooth surface without another paid probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed gradients are at or below 2.2, below the cited siphon threshold region; there is no evidence that this probe is needed to fit the sampled regime.
The auxiliary reading does not resolve the input-response relationship and is explicitly not worth its cost.
Observed response changes strongly with s_grad at overlapping u_now values, which a u-only Haldane curve cannot explain.
A smooth monotone power surface does not naturally capture the observed decline with increasing sink gradient.
